title: Very nice towels.
text: Very nice towels.. I am not a fan of the corners of these towels, the design is okay and very contemporary, although not a fan of the figures. I would say the quality is great and pretty absorbent. Overall glad I bought these, immediately put them to good use.

product_metadata.title: Intelligent Design Lita 100% Cotton Luxurious Bath Towel Set, Jacquard Geometric Design, Highly Absorbent, Quick Dry, Hotel & Spa Quality for Bathroom, Multi-Sizes, Grey/ Yellow 6 Piece
features: Intelligent Design Lita 6 Piece Towel Set to your bathroom for a fun and chic update!
Premium 100% cotton bath towel set features 2-ply ring spun combed woven cotton jacquard construction makes each towel incredibly absorbent and soft.
These cotton towels are also OEKO-TEX certified, meaning they do not contain any harmful substances, ensuring quality comfort and wellness.
Set includes: 2 Bath Towels: 28"W x 54"L, 4 Hand Towels: 16"W x 26"L
Care Instruction: For your convenience it's machine washable.Do not use bleach.Commercial size washer and dryer is recommended for best result.
description: These 2-ply ring spun towels are cotton jacquard woven making them reversible in contrasting colors as well as incredibly absorbent. Each towel features a bold teal geometric print with a small grey dobby border. Set includes two bath towels and four hand towels.
